reviews.samplingRule: two deterministic train pairs for each of 47 upstream themes
notes: All sampled pairs share a broad subject, scene, object or photographic series suitable for A/B comparison.
A small number of upstream theme names are visually noisy, for example a canyon pair under family; theme is used only for coverage balancing and is never emitted as the training reason code.
Preference labels remain the released TAD66K aggregate scores and were not manually relabeled during this comparability review.
